preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 2 * 10**5 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size of the array N is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(-1 <= int(x) < N for x in input().split()) for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each element of the array A is between -1 and N-1 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == '-1' or (isinstance(return_value[i], list) and len(return_value[i]) == N and all(1 <= x <= N for x in return_value[i]) and len(set(return_value[i])) == N) for i, N in enumerate([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' or a permutation of size N containing each element from 1 to N exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == '-1' or all((A[j] == -1 or A[j] == max(k for k in range(j) if P[k] > P[j])) for j in range(N)) for i, (N, A, P) in enumerate(zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)], return_value if return_value != '-1' else [])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a permutation P exists, the array A can be generated from P using the given method.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == '-1' or return_value[i] == sorted(return_value[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a permutation P exists, it is the lexicographically smallest permutation.
